title: password strength meter
rule: While a new password is typed, show a strength meter (and rules) so the user can see whether the value meets the system’s bar.

citation.source: Designing Interfaces 3e ch. Getting Input — Password Strength Meter (Tidwell, Brewer, Valencia); NN/g — 10 Design Guidelines for Reporting Errors in Forms (§2)

pass_when: During new-password entry, a meter and the rules are visible and update.
fail_when: New-password field has no meter and/or no rules while typing.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
